_doc: Regions an appellation is listed under beside its own (scripts/_lib/region_aliases.py). `entries`: slug → {country, regions, evidence: [{file, field, quote}] (verbatim from the extracted record; tests/test_region_aliases.py checks each quote), reason, verified}; `regions: []` suppresses the automatic derivations (member-PDO table, FR aire communes) for that record. `rejected`: slug → {region: reason} — geometric candidates of scripts/sweep_region_aliases.py that are not a second region (polygon overlaps, a neighbour's filing).

dunavska-ravnina.reason: Its obshtini of the Varna and Dobrich oblasts hold the PDOs Варна and Евксиноград, filed under Черноморски район (853 of 854 and 685 of 686 km² inside its polygon).

trakiiska-nizina.reason: The southern PGI: its obshtini cover the Burgas PDOs (Черноморски район), the Struma valley (Благоевград) and the Rose valley (Стара Загора, Пловдив) — 85 %, 99.9 % and 99.9 % of those regions' PDO polygons.

pitsilia.reason: Its villages straddle the Limassol and Nicosia districts (Lagoudera, Palaichori, Fikardou, Farmakas are Nicosia district): 237 of its 354 km² lie in the Λευκωσία PGI.

bayerischer-bodensee-landwein.reason: No alias: its member table draws it as the whole Baden Anbaugebiet (PDO-DE-A1264, 13,231 km²) for a Landwein of the Lindau shore, so the derived Baden alias would repeat a geometry defect (CURATOR_TODO).

benaco-bresciano.Veneto: Brescia communes only; the overlap is Lugana's Brescia part (Lugana is filed under Veneto).

civitella-d-agliano.Umbria: Viterbo (Lazio) only; the overlap is Orvieto's Lazio part (Orvieto is filed under Umbria).

lefkosia.Λεμεσός: The Nicosia district only; the overlap is Pitsilia's Nicosia-district villages (Pitsilia is filed under Λεμεσός).

clairette-de-bellegarde.VALLEE DU RHÔNE: One commune, Bellegarde, which the Costières de Nîmes aire also holds — a shared commune, not an appellation spanning two regions.

bayerischer-bodensee-landwein.Baden: Its member table draws the whole Baden Anbaugebiet for a Landwein of the Lindau shore (geometry defect, CURATOR_TODO); the alias is suppressed in `entries`.
bayerischer-bodensee-landwein.Württemberg: The Baden polygon's Bétard overlap with Württemberg; see baden.

baden.Württemberg: Bétard polygons of Baden and Württemberg overlap by 4,157 km²; the two Anbaugebiete are disjoint (CURATOR_TODO).

badischer-landwein.Württemberg: Drawn as the Baden polygon; see baden.

landwein-oberrhein.Württemberg: Drawn as the Baden polygon; see baden.

schwabischer-landwein.Baden: Drawn as the Württemberg polygon; see baden.

landwein-neckar.Baden: Drawn as the Württemberg polygon; see baden.

mittelrhein.Mosel: Bétard overlap of neighbouring Anbaugebiete (106 km²).

etyek-buda.Felső-Magyarország: Bétard overlap with Mátra (526 km²; CURATOR_TODO).

matra.Felső-Pannon: Bétard overlap with Etyek-Buda; see etyek-buda.

felso-magyarorszag.Felső-Pannon: Drawn from its member PDOs, Mátra among them; see etyek-buda.

bizeljcan.Podravje: Bétard overlap with Štajerska Slovenija (630 km²; CURATOR_TODO).

podravje.Posavje: Drawn from its member PDOs; see bizeljcan.

posavje.Podravje: Drawn from its member PDOs; see bizeljcan.

chernomorski-raion.Дунавска равнина: Bétard draws the PDO over north-east Bulgaria, where Дунавска равнина's own text claims the obshtini.

tavora-varosa.Douro/Porto: Border overlap with the Douro demarcation (66 km², 14 %) in the municípios the two share; not checked against the two cadernos (CURATOR_TODO).
